intent: Late arrival in rehearsal RSVP, per-date availability polls and admin overview
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, continuation of the supplied German theater Flutter app design.
Create ONE crisp high-fidelity landscape board containing THREE straight-on portrait mobile screens side by side for the app "Rampenlicht". Supplied images are visual references. Preserve their warm ivory #F8F6F0, dark forest #202823, burnt orange #E96131, sage green and muted amber, restrained native controls, clean typography. No perspective or physical phone photography. Small external captions "Komme später", "Terminabstimmung", "Probenleitung". Tiny board note "Entwurf mit Beispieldaten". High resolution, very readable German. Feature: an explicit late-arrival response, distinct from an unanswered response and from physical check-in.
SCREEN 1 member rehearsal response:
Top back arrow, "Deine Probe", share icon. Small production "Wenn das Licht angeht", title "Szenenprobe".
Compact metadata with icons: "Donnerstag, 17. September", "19:00 bis 21:00", "Kolpingheim · Großer Saal".
Divider. Heading "Bist du dabei?"
Three compact full-width response choice rows, each with a distinct icon and literal text:
neutral check row "Bin dabei";
selected pale amber clock row "Komme später";
neutral x row "Kann nicht".
Below selected options a labelled compact time field "Voraussichtlich da ab" containing "19:30 Uhr" with time picker icon, and small helper "Uhrzeit optional".
Full-width orange button "Späterkommen speichern".
Below a restrained book link "Für diese Probe · Szenen 1 und 2" with next arrow.
No separate comment field or long explanation. This screen is editing a late arrival, not claiming saved or physically present yet.
SCREEN 2 member availability poll:
Back arrow, "Terminabstimmung".
Title "Wann können wir proben?"
Small instruction "Gib für jeden Termin Bescheid."
Three generously spaced but compact date option blocks, no calendar grid.
First "Do, 17. September · 19:00", with a segmented choice row "Dabei" | "Später" | "Kann nicht"; Später selected amber. Under it a compact inline field "Da ab 19:30 Uhr" with clock and edit icon. This time belongs ONLY to this first date.
Second "So, 20. September · 15:00", same three choices, Dabei selected sage. No arrival time field on this date.
Third "Do, 24. September · 19:00", same three choices, Kann nicht selected muted terracotta. No arrival time field on this date.
Bottom orange button "Antworten speichern".
Quiet note "Du kannst deine Antworten später ändern."
These are per-date availability answers, not a separate poll option named later. No totals on this screen.
SCREEN 3 admin incoming responses, NOT physical check-in:
Back arrow, "Rückmeldungen", quiet Admin badge.
Title "Szenenprobe".
Small "17. September · 19:00".
A compact 2-by-2 summary grid with precisely FOUR MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE COUNTS: "1 dabei" sage, "1 später" amber, "1 abgesagt" muted terracotta, "1 offen" neutral. Total ensemble FOUR people. No separate total that double-counts later.
Exactly four member rows with initials avatars and roles:
"Alex" / "LENA" / status "Dabei" sage.
"Sam" / "OSKAR" / status "Später · 19:30" amber with clock.
"Mira" / "FINN" / status "Abgesagt" muted terracotta.
"Robin" / "NORA" / status "Offen" neutral.
After divider a modest section "Für die Planung" with short body "LENA ab 19:00 eingeplant." and "OSKAR voraussichtlich ab 19:30."
Outlined action "Szenen planen" with next arrow.
Very small footer "Anwesenheit wird vor Ort erfasst."
Crucial semantics: a later ETA does not mean physically present and does not automatically mark present when the clock reaches the ETA. Keep this distinction through headings and labels, not warnings. No large explanatory cards. All data fictional. The result should look like calm, usable native Flutter UI consistent with the references.
